book.name: Jone
book.title: WAI PII EPE JONEME PEPA PIAMO DOKO

content: Lasarusa Kumiamo Doko
Yuu yakane Betani dokonya tange akali Lasarusa lenge doko yaina sia. Mariapa, baanya kakingi Matapa dolapo yuu dokonya tange.

(Maria dokome wele tunduma pipae mendeme Kamongonya moko kai pyatakamai, baanya aiyomba itimi moko tombe lea dupa kunao nepakamaiya enda dokoaka. Yaina sia akali Lasarusa lenge doko, enda dokonya pimalenge.)
Lasarusa baa yaina siamosa, pimalenge dolapome “Kamongo, embanya auu kaenge akali doko yaina silyamona” lao wai leambi.
Jisasame wai doko sepala lao pituu,

content.text: “Yaina dokome baa kumasala naeyalapomo. Yaina dokonya-kaita Gotenya kenge andake doko baanya Ikiningi doko-kisa panasetamopa, baanya Ikiningi doko kenge andake nyetana”

content: lea.
Matapi, baanya kakingi Mariapi, Lasarusapi dutupa Jisasame auu kaenge.
Baame Lasarusa yaina silyamo lapae doko sepala, baa katea yuu dokonya yuu gii lapoma apata katea.
Katapala baanya disaipolo dupa lamaiyoo,
lea.
Dopa leamopa disaipolo dupame baa lamaiyoo, “Mana Lenge, indupa Juu dupame emba kaname pyalanya kaitini kutilyamino doko, emba yuu dokonya deaka patepe?” leami.
Dokopa Jisasame yanu pyao,

content.text: “Yongama pituu alemandi tuu lao, kiloko gii dutupa 12 awa daa kandamuape? Endakali mende kotaka paenge-tamo doko, baa isa yuu dakenya tii pipae dokonya kandao paelyamopa lombapae nasingi.
Dopaka doko, endakali mende-kisa tii pipae doko nasilyamopa iminjetaenya paenge-tamo doko, baa lombapae singina”

content: lea.
Baame pii dutupa latala dokaita lamaiyoo,

content.text: “Naimanya mona setenge Lasarusa doko luu palelyamona, nambame baa pyale tala patoana”

content: lea.
Dokopa baanya disaipolo dupame lao pituu, “Kamongo, baa luu palitamo doko, baa yaka jalapomona” leami.
Lasarusa luu palelyamona Jisasame lea doko, baa kumatapyana lao lea. Dopaka doko, baa luu palimupa lelyape lao Jisasanya disaipolo dupame masiami.
Dopa lao masiaminosa Jisasame dokaita panao lamaiyoo,

content.text: Nyakamame namba tungi pyalapale lao, Lasarusa kumapya dokonya namba nakatapu dokonya eteke pilyo. Dopaka doko, naima baa silyamo dokonya mua”

content: lea.
Akali Tomasa, kenge mende Pakao Mandipae lenge dokome disaipolo yangi dupa lamaiyoo, “Naima apata Jisasa-pipa kumamana mua” lea.
Sakatasingi Dokopa, Lete Katasingi Dokopa, Dolapo Nambana Leamo Doko
Jisasa pao Betani pyakamatala, Lasarusa malu piami doko yuu gii kitomende patelyamo leamino sia.
(Betani pituu Jerusalema doko 3 kilomitapi mende.)
Matapa, Mariapanya pimalenge doko kumia dokonya, enda dolapo-pipa enda waka mendapu kumanda peteami. Peteami dokonya, Juu longo ipao kumanda peteamiaka.
Peteaminopa, Jisasa epelyamo leamino Matame sepala, kaitinisa kandanyalanya peamopa, Maria baa andaka petea.
Matame Jisasa kandanyetala baa lamaiyoo, “Kamongo, emba ae kateeli doko, nambanya pimalenge doko kumala naeyali.
Dopaka doko, embame dopale mende Gote-kisa tee lateno doko, indupapi Goteme emba dyaapomona lao nambame masilyona” lea.
Dopa leamopa Jisasame baa lamaiyoo,
lea.
Dokopa Matame baa lamaiyoo, “Yuu etata gii dokopa, endakali kumapae dupa sakatataminopa, baa apata sakatatana lao nambame masilyona” lea.
Dokopa Jisasame baa lamaiyoo,

content.text: “Endakali kumapae dupa sakatasingi doko namba. Endakali dupa lete katasingi doko nambaka. Endakali mendeme namba tungi pyatamo doko, baa kumapalapi lete katata.
Namba tungi pyao katatami endakali dupa pitaka kumala naeyao kataowaka katatami. Embame pii doko kiningina lao masilyipi?”

content: lea.
Dokopa Matame Jisasa lamaiyoo, “Kiningi, Kamongo emba Gote Ikiningi, isa yuu dakenya akali ipatana latae Kraisa dokona lao nambame masilyona” lea.
Jisasa Baa Ee Leamo Doko

Matame pii dutupa latala andaka peamopa, Jisasa baa yuu yakane Betani dokonya apata paa naenya, Matame baa kandanyia panda dosa katao kaeya. Dokopa Matame baanya kakingi Maria epena latala elyakalao lamaiyoo, “Mana Lenge doko ae ipupala, emba ipu lelyamona” lea. Dokopa Mariame pii doko sepala, baa yapa sakatao Jisasa katea dokonya pea.
Dokopa Juu mendapu Maria-pipa kumanda peteami dupame kandeaminopa, Maria baa yapa sakatatala kamaka peanya watao pao pituu, “Baa malunya ee laa pelyamona” leami.

Dokopa Maria baa Jisasa katea dokonya ipupala Jisasa kandea. Kandatala Jisasanya moko katea dosa pao luma lakapala baa lamaiyoo, “Kamongo, emba ae kateeli doko, nambanya pimalenge doko kumala naeyalina” lea.
Dopa latala Maria baa ee leamopa, baa-pipa epeami Juu dupa apata eaka leami. Jisasame ee leami dokaita kandatala, baa mona etete kenda kaeyapala, masepae longo nyia.
Nyepala Jisasame lao pituu,
lea. Dopa leamopa dokaitame yanu pyao, “Kamongo, embame kanja ipu” leami.
Dopa leaminopa Jisasa baa ee lea.
Ee leamosa Juu dupame lao pituu, “Akali doko baame etete auu kaenge-lamo kanjepa” leami.
Dopa leaminopa yangi dupame lao pituu, “Lenge monda mende lenge auu pyoo tena leamo akali dokome akali dake kumala naena lao nisala naeyapyalipi?” leami.
Lasarusa Malunya Sakatasiamo Doko
Dopa leaminopa, Jisasa dee mona etete kenda kaeyapala, malu dokonya pea. (Malu doko kananda mendenya petala, kambu doko kana yale mendeme piti petae katea.)
Dokopa Jisasame lao pituu,

lea. Dopa leamopa, akali kumapae dokonya pimalenge Matame baa lamaiyoo, “Kamongo, baanya yonge doko malu petae katamupa yuu gii kitomende patapyana, indupa baanya yonge doko ai koeyapae pyalapomona” lea.
Dokopa Jisasame baa lamaiyoo,

content.text: “Embame namba tungi pyateno doko, Gotenya tii pipae doko kanjapenona lao nambame emba langya naeyalope?”

content: lea.
Dopa lateamopa, malu dokonya kambu piti piami kana doko nyoo kapya leami. Dopa peteaminopa, Jisasame kaiti-kisa kandalyetae katao lao pituu,

content.text: “Apane, nambame loma silyo doko embame sekelyeno dokonya, nambame emba yaka pilyino lelyo.
Nambanya loma silyo dupa embame koteaka lao sekengena lao nambame masilyo. Dopaka doko, embame namba puu lea-lamo lao endakali asa kalyamino dupame masina latala nambame dopa lelyona”

content: lea.
Dopa latala baame puu lao, lao pituu,
lea.

Dopa lateamopa akali kumapae doko kamaka pyakalyia. Baanya kingi mokopi dupa lapalapa kende yakane londe mendeme yaki piamili petae kateamopa, lapalapa kepapae mendeme lenge-lyaapi dolapo ambo piamili petae doko kamaka pyakalyia. Dopa piamopa Jisasame endakali dokaita lamaiyoo,

content.text: “Baa pena, yaki dupa tata lao nepakamaiyepa”

content: lea.
Jisasa Pyao Kumasalanya Kambuiyamino Doko
Jisasame Lasarusa sakatasiamo kandatala, Maria kanja epeami Juu longo dupame Jisasa tungi piami.
Dopaka doko, yangi Parasi dupa kateami dokonya pupala, Jisasame pia dupa lamaiyami.
Dokopa prisa mupapi, Parasipi dupame kanjole dupa nyoo kambu pyatala lamaiyoo, “Akali dokome mirakolo longo pilyamo dokonya, naimame aipa pima?

Baame dopaka pyoo katena kaeyatamano doko, endakali pitakame baa tungi pyalamino. Dopa pitaminopa, Roma tange amii dupa ipupala, naimanya panda dake kaluu nepao, naima tata dupa pyao koeyasoo pitamina” leami.
Dokopa akali dupanya mende, Kaeyapasa lenge doko, ee kana dokonya prisa mupa katea dokome dokaita lamaiyoo, “Nyakamame kukipi mende masala naelyamino.
Naima tata dupa pitaka kumala naena lao, akali mendai mendeme naimanya panda nyoo kumatamo dokome naima nisetana lao nyakamame masala naelyamipi?” lea.
(Pii doko baa tangeme masoo nalea. Baa ee kana dokonya prisa mupa katea dokomena, Juu tata dupa pitakanya panda nyoo Jisasa kumatana lao propesi pii lea.)
Pii lea doko, Jisasa kumata dokome Juu tata dupa iki nisetana lao nalea. Baa kumata dokome Gotenya wane yuu waka dupanya katenge dupa nyoo pyasoo, kambu mendai jina latana lao lea.
Kaeyapasame lea gii dokonya pituu, kanjole dupame Jisasa pyao kumasemana lao kambuiyami.

Dopa piaminosa, Jisasa baa Juu dupanya kainanya dee panao napaeya. Baa yuu doko yakinatala, taono Epraimi lenge mende, endakali napalenge yuu mendepa makisa singi dokonya baanya disaipolo dupa-pipa pupala kateami.
Dokopa Juumanya Pasopa nee nenge gii doko tengesa piamopa, yuu yakane dupanya katao endakali longo kuni nasina lao pyoo wasalanya lalyoo Jerusalema peami.
Pupala dupame Jisasa kutiami. Kutapala lotuu anda nee nyetae kamapu dokonya katao nyakama-lapo laloo pyoo, “Nyakamame aipa lao masilyami? Baa nee andake dakenya nala naipapepe?” leami.
(Endakali mendeme Jisasa dosa kalyamo lao kandea-kandeno doko, baa anjemana langina lao prisa mupapi, Parasipi dupame kyeto joo wamba lateami.)
